targetCompanyImage.name: Caturus
targetCompanyImage.subsector: Integrated natural gas and LNG platform
targetCompanyImage.description: Caturus is an integrated U.S. natural-gas and LNG platform whose legal parent is Caturus Holdco, LLC, renamed from SoTex HoldCo in August 2025. The platform combines Caturus Energy's Texas upstream production with the controlled 9.5 mtpa Commonwealth LNG export project in Cameron Parish, Louisiana. After the May 14, 2026 CPP Investments closing, regulatory filings support a direct governance cap table of 52.6% Kimmeridge-managed interests, 24.1% Mubadala, 22.8% CPP Investments and 0.5% Caturus management. CPP also has a disclosed economic look-through through Kimmeridge-managed funds, but that indirect interest carries no additional governance and public CPP percentages use a different aggregation basis; the 22.8% direct interest is therefore used for the ownership row. Kimmeridge's exact fund allocation and CPP's primary-versus-secondary mix are not publicly disclosed. Caturus reported more than 1 Bcfe per day of net production across approximately 280,000 net acres after the Galvan Ranch acquisition, while Commonwealth LNG reached FID and closed project financing in May 2026. Caturus Energy and Commonwealth LNG are subordinate operating subsidiaries/projects, not separate manager-level PortCos, and project financiers are not parent owners. No later platform sale, owner exit, cancellation or signed pending ownership transfer was identified through August 19, 2026.

milestones.event: CPP Investments disclosed an initial economic interest in Caturus; later regulatory filings distinguish the indirect and direct components.
CPP Investments closed a 22.8% direct Caturus interest as the current direct cap table took effect; Commonwealth LNG simultaneously reached FID and financing close.
Kimmeridge-managed funds closed development-capital funding for Commonwealth LNG, establishing the initial investment later consolidated within Caturus.
A Kimmeridge affiliate closed the acquisition of 100% of Commonwealth LNG, creating the controlled LNG component of the integrated platform.
Mubadala's 24.1% investment closed and SoTex HoldCo was renamed Caturus Holdco, LLC.
A Department of Energy notice documented the Mubadala closing, the Caturus rename and the platform's legal ownership chain.
